question: Can early-window evidence be emitted through a pixel boundary that is demonstrably invariant to changed late outcomes, and is any already sealed paper ready for that review?
synthetic_gate: Before using the crop on any untouched outcomes, mutate black, white and colored pixels in every part of the late plotting region. Require byte equality of allowed crops and prove genuine early changes remain visible. Reject overlapping axis strips, out-of-image requests, and over-wide or invalid plot windows.
regression_reference: Use Phase 45 quarantined mango panels only to reproduce invariance on native publisher geometry. Do not reopen or compute exact outcomes.

sealed_candidates.10.1002/gch2.202300315: Fungal carbon; confirm biomass and cycling versus rate or application-only evidence.
sealed_candidates.10.3390/ma15165748: Seaweed carbon; distinguish 3E electrode optimization/rate measurements from long-cycle test.
sealed_candidates.10.1002/smll.202513011: Mixed storage applications; find whether carbon has eligible biomass precursor and the cycling result belongs to a supercapacitor.

source_boundary: Use sealed JATS and only emit identifiers, presence or absence of fixed flags for own material and cycle, figure or panel identifiers, and status. Only stage an original figure if precursor, system, role and own cycling panel all verified; separate pixel review in a later freeze. No abstracts, captions or values emitted.
